programme.title: Breakthrough

programme.title: Safe House
programme.desc: Denzel Washington and Ryan Reynolds must survive the streets of Cape Town in this high energy action film. After a safe house is attacked, a CIA agent must protect his charge.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: The second in this highly successful action franchise sees Matt Damon reprise his role as a former CIA assassin. This time, he's forced to resume his former life after being framed.

programme.title: Wrong Place
programme.desc: Bruce Willis finds himself as the prey in this action thriller. A former police chief is hunted down to prevent him from delivering eyewitness testimony against a drug family.

programme.title: Zone 414
programme.desc: Guy Pearce drives this sci-fi thriller as a private investigator tasked with finding a tech billionaire's missing daughter. He teams up with an advanced AI to solve the mystery.

programme.title: Four Good Days
programme.desc: In this touching true-life-inspired story, Glenn Close portrays a mother trying to help her drug-addicted daughter (Mila Kunis). They have four crucial days of recovery ahead of them.

programme.title: Stowaway
programme.desc: A party girl fights to survive after three thieves commandeer her luxury yacht. Trapped on the high seas, she turns the tables on the intruders and takes matters into her own hands.

programme.title: Spencer
programme.desc: Kristen Stewart earned an Oscar nomination for portraying Princess Diana in this true story-based film about when she divorced Prince Charles during the Christmas holidays.

programme.title: Welcome To The Family
programme.desc: At the point of getting engaged, life is turned upside down for Lerato and Vusi when his two mothers manipulate them into coming to his home in KZN.

programme.title: Something New
programme.desc: Looking for an at-home date movie? Simon Baker (The Mentalist) stars in this feel-good romp about interracial romance and following your heart to love.

programme.title: Schuks! Pay Back The Money
programme.desc: The legendary South African comedian, Leon Schuster returns for another crazy film, filled with even bigger antics and chaos.

programme.title: The Ant Bully
programme.desc: A fun and colourful animated adventure with the voices of Julia Roberts and Nicholas Cage. A ten-year-old boy is shrunk down to the size of an ant after he floods a colony.

programme.title: Sinbad: Legend Of The Seven Seas
programme.desc: Brad Pitt and Catherine Zeta-Jones star in this animation. The legendary Sinbad embarks on a dangerous journey. He must clear his name after being framed by the goddess Eris.

programme.title: Paddington 2
programme.desc: Paddington's delightful adventures continue in this BAFTA-nominated sequel. After a beloved book is stolen, Paddington and the Browns must find the crafty thief behind the crime.

programme.title: Wrath Of The Titans
programme.desc: The demigod son of Zeus must leave his peaceful life behind and become a warrior again when his father is kidnapped. He enlists the help of a warrior queen to face Zeus's captors.

programme.title: The Fast And The Furious
programme.desc: Vin Diesel and the late Paul Walker team up for the first instalment of the popular franchise, which sees a cop go undercover to infiltrate a racing crew.

programme.title: The Bourne Ultimatum
programme.desc: In this three-time Oscar winner, the iconic Bourne trilogy reaches a riveting climax as Jason Bourne looks for the origins of his life as a trained killer.

programme.title: High Rollers
programme.desc: The risks are twice as high in this sequel to the 2024 crime action. Mason (John Travolta) and his crew attempt a high-stakes casino heist to save his kidnapped girlfriend.

programme.title: Matwetwe
programme.desc: MATWETWE (WIZARD) is a coming-of-age adventure following Lefa and Papi, best friends and recent high school graduates. The boys try to score a huge deal and save their lives.

programme.title: Beautiful Disaster
programme.desc: Based on a book of the same name by Jamie McGuire. Follow the life of a college freshman who tries to distance herself from her dark past while resisting her attraction to a bad boy.

programme.title: Knives Out
programme.desc: This book-inspired murder mystery boasts an all-star cast led by Daniel Craig. When a famous crime writer is found dead, a seasoned detective is enlisted to solve the mystery.

programme.title: Love The Coopers
programme.desc: The gloves come off in this festive comedy with an all-star cast. When a dysfunctional family come together for Christmas, everything else seems to fall apart.

programme.title: Umakoti Wethu
programme.desc: A young woman falls in love with the second wife her husband decides to take. Can they all make it work, or will someone become the third wheel?

programme.title: Harriet
programme.desc: A touching and inspiring biopic focused on the life of a prominent US freedom fighter. Harriet Tubman escapes slavery and devotes her life to abolishing the practice.

programme.title: Frank & Fearless
programme.desc: Leon Schuster returns for another crazy misadventure. After a rhino is killed by poachers, four friends decide to kidnap the ambassador of a South-East Asian country.

programme.title: Marmaduke
programme.desc: A fun animated film based on a classic newspaper comic strip. A legendary dog trainer tries to train an undisciplined dog in a bid to turn him into a World Dog Championship contender.

programme.title: Mosley
programme.desc: An enchanting family animation. Mosley rebels from a life of servitude to uncover the origins of his species after learning that his fellow thoriphants used to stand upright.

programme.title: Spirit: Stallion Of The Cimarron
programme.desc: This Oscar nominee for Best Animated Feature film sees a young mustang stallion become the leader of his herd. But when he is captured, he's forced to fight for his freedom.

programme.title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding 2
programme.desc: In this sequel to the 2002 hit 'My Big Fat Greek Wedding', the revelation of a family secret and an even bigger, fatter wedding bring the Portokalos family together again.

programme.title: Beast
programme.desc: In this action-packed movie shot in South Africa, Idris Elba fights for his family's survival as a rogue lion hunts a father and his teenage daughters.

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: Jeremy Renner joins this gripping franchise. When the names of all the black ops agents are threatened with exposure, the agency tries to get rid of everyone on the list.

programme.title: Thina Sobabili
programme.desc: A drama filled with love, heartbreak and family. Set in a township, a brother and sister do everything to try and survive the harsh environment they live in.
